scope: Mac-only immutable task events and commit-before-checkpoint durability

defectReproduction.failure: The first event-enabled sustained run timed out while waiting for soak-turn-11.

residualDirectoryAfterLeakedAppContinued.note: The later residual state is not evidence of permanent loss; it confirms the app continued after the script timeout.

defectReproduction.rootCause: AsyncThrowingStream yield does not wait for its consumer. The source saved the batch-final checkpoint before SessionRepository and TaskRunStore had durably committed every yielded event, creating a crash-loss window.

durabilityRules: Event and Run are committed in one atomic TaskRunStore replacement.
Codex prepares a checkpoint at each complete JSONL line and permits one unacknowledged delivery at a time.
The coordinator acknowledges only after SessionRepository and TaskRunStore both commit.
Repository or disk failure leaves the previous checkpoint replayable.
Known stale or invalid domain facts are acknowledged and discarded to avoid an infinite replay loop.

automatedVerification.macOSBuild: Anchor macOS arm64 Debug build succeeded with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

bonjourIsolation.finding: A previously launched production Anchor instance advertised the same Bonjour service name and caused existing client tests to select the wrong endpoint.
bonjourIsolation.action: Stopped only the identified prior validation instance and reran without changing transport behavior.
bonjourIsolation.result: All Local link codec tests and the full suite passed in isolation.

limitations: Lifecycle rows were synthetic privacy-minimal Codex JSONL, not a live model turn.
The unsigned Debug build does not prove provisioned App Sandbox access.
No iPhone or cross-device synchronization was used.
The run was approximately half a minute, not a multi-hour, sleep-wake, or overnight observation.
Codex turn_aborted currently maps to a generic failed outcome because this file source does not expose a more specific abort reason.
The changes remain uncommitted and have not been pushed, merged, installed, or released.
